'''Laren''' is a high-ranking servant in the [[Tarasin Palace]] in [[Ebou Dar]], [[Altara]]. She is round with dark eyebrows, nearly black eyes and a touch of gray at her temples. She wears a [[marriage knife]], indicating that one of her five daughters and two of her four sons are dead.
==Activities==
[[Madic]] takes Mat to Larin when he wants to see [[Elayne]] and [[Nynaeve]]. She disappears out of sight when they confront [[Teslyn]] and [[Joline]]. She reappears, however, to summon Mat to [[Tylin]]. He is glad that she comes to save him from the [[Aes Sedai]], but Laren assures him that the Queen really wants to see him.

When the strange relationship between Mat and the Queen starts, Larin personally brings Mat a basket sent by Tylin for breakfast as she did with supper the night before.
